sentence: On her way to school, Katie thought of the argument she had with Sarah the day before and wiped tears from her eyes. "I can't believe I fought with my best friend," she cried. "I just want things to go back to normal." It seemed that nothing could help her overcome this painful moment. As she walked into her classroom, she heard a familiar voice. Sarah was calling her name. "Katie, I'm sorry for the things I said yesterday." A big smile spread across Katie's face. "I'm sorry, too. Let's never fight again." Katie and Sarah hugged each other tightly and laughed the way they always did before.
